chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a people in a village who do not have anyone to lead the Jumuʿah for them: should they pray Zuhr on Friday in congregation? He said: Yes, if they do not fear.

key_terms.الظُّهْرَ: the Zuhr prayer performed at midday
key_terms.لَمْ يَخَافُوا: if they do not fear, meaning in the absence of danger or apprehension
key_terms.يَجْمَعُ: to lead or establish the Friday congregational prayer
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day of congregational prayer

ai.seo_question: Can people pray Zuhr in congregation on Friday if they cannot establish Jumuʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling for people in a village who do not have someone to establish the Friday prayer for them. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that they may perform the Zuhr prayer in congregation on Friday, provided that they are not under fear.
